paired_requirement_wording: Both hidden variants use one identical declarative wrapper and manually paired declarative bodies frozen in paired-requirements.json. Variant-specific instructional prefixes are forbidden and validated before sealing.
variant_assignment: For each of 30 cases and five paired replicate indices, (case_index + replicate_index) parity assigns one hidden requirement variant identically across all three conditions. Fifteen even and fifteen odd case indices yield 75 source-faithful and 75 injected-drift target-replicate pairs, or 225 runs per variant.
workspace_base_note: Public origin/main immediately before the source-frozen delayed-feedback audit and target-drift case artifacts were added.
primary_endpoint: expert-adjudicated exact contract satisfaction under hidden balanced source-faithful versus injected-drift requirements
primary_analysis_unit: target, after aggregating the five paired replicate outcomes within target and condition
secondary_endpoints: false_rejection_rate (descriptive exact complement of specificity; excluded from BH)
recovery_cost_definition: Number of adapter trace tool_call events marked recovery_phase=true after the first observable failed Lean build; raw build attempts, wall time, tokens, and monetary cost are reported separately. Proof-route failures without an observable failed Lean build are outside this estimand.
build_observation_grammar: An observable Lean build is a direct lake build or lake env lean invocation at command start or after &&, ||, ;, or a newline. Mentions such as echo lake build are not build attempts. More than one direct build in one command event is ambiguous_build_accounting and makes the run infrastructure_failure.
wording_negative_control: Before primary execution, freeze and report the deterministic leave-one-pair-out text-only diagnostic, one independent blind wording review, and one frozen-model source-absent label audit. These controls quantify residual prior-knowledge or wording predictability; they are not formalization outcomes and cannot be pooled with the 450 runs.
dependence_plan: Aggregate replicates within target before paired inference; report each source paper and the textbook stratum separately; use a source/target-aware hierarchical bootstrap and an exact sign-flip over three paper-source clusters plus twelve textbook targets; do not treat six probes from one paper or five replicates from one target as independent papers or targets.
pilot_policy: Exactly one case by three conditions by one replicate may be used for an end-to-end infrastructure smoke test. Pilot outputs are permanently excluded from the 450-run result set.
replacement_policy: Never replace a challenge or requirement variant after observing workflow difficulty or failure.
missing_run_policy: Freeze complete_450_no_replacement_no_imputation_v1 before execution. Continue the remaining preregistered schedule after an individual failure; never replace a run and never impute an outcome. A sealed completion ledger must cover all 450 semantic run IDs. Blind grading and inferential analysis require 450/450 production-result-eligible records; otherwise emit only a cause/condition/variant missingness report with no effect estimate, interval, p-value, or success claim.
blinding_boundary: Evaluated agents receive opaque run IDs and one proposed requirement. The checker sandbox receives only a pristine condition-view snapshot, submitted patch, public declaration names, expected file hashes, and opaque/hash bindings; it never receives the sealed pack, operator metadata, source bank, challenge ground truth, semantic IDs, condition label, or requirement variant. Primary graders receive normalized final artifacts and neutral post-hoc checker evidence, not condition labels, prompt paths, presentation order, contract/blueprint provenance, or internal gate names.
workflow_manipulation_check: Every run emits a hash-bound workflow-compliance record. Compile-only has no condition-specific evidence file; source-aware must hash a run-local blueprint; ABRL must hash a target contract, blueprint, failure ledger, and promotion-gate log. Primary graders see only the common pass/fail check, not the condition-specific artifacts.
